lines.text: Divide each length by 10. A scale of 1 : 10 turns 10 cm into 1 cm.

steps.ask: A box has six faces in three pairs of equal rectangles. What size is each pair?

Add a $\hl{1}{2} \times \hl{2}{3}$ rectangle to each side of the second rectangle, to make the two ends of the box.
